AuthIdentity.definition:
model AuthIdentity {
  id             String     @id @default(cuid())
  tenantId       String
  userId         String
  provider       String
  providerUserId String
  email          String?
  phone          String?
  profileJson    Json?
  createdAt      DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime   @updatedAt
  tenant         Tenant     @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user           User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  membership     Membership @relation("AuthIdentityMembership", fields: [userId, tenantId], references: [userId, tenantId], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([id, tenantId])
  @@unique([tenantId, provider, providerUserId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([tenantId, provider])
}

AuthSession.definition:
model AuthSession {
  id            String             @id @default(cuid())
  tenantId      String?
  userId        String
  deviceLabel   String
  ipHash        String?
  expiresAt     DateTime
  lastUsedAt    DateTime           @default(now())
  revokedAt     DateTime?
  revokeReason  String?
  createdAt     DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime           @updatedAt
  tenant        Tenant?            @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user          User               @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  membership    Membership?        @relation("AuthSessionMembership", fields: [userId, tenantId], references: [userId, tenantId], onDelete: Cascade)
  refreshTokens AuthRefreshToken[]

  @@index([tenantId, userId, revokedAt])
  @@index([userId, revokedAt])
  @@index([expiresAt])
  @@index([revokedAt])
}

ClientConsentFact.definition:
model ClientConsentFact {
  id                   String   @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId             String
  clientId             String
  kind                 String
  decision             String
  occurredAt           DateTime
  effectiveAt          DateTime
  sourceType           String
  sourceIdentityHash   String
  actorUserId          String?
  actionExecutionId    String?
  createdAt            DateTime @default(now())

  tenant      Tenant           @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  client      Client           @relation(fields: [clientId, tenantId], references: [id, tenantId], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Restrict)
  actor       Membership?      @relation("ClientConsentActor", fields: [actorUserId, tenantId], references: [userId, tenantId], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Restrict)
  execution   ActionExecution? @relation(fields: [actionExecutionId, tenantId], references: [id, tenantId], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Restrict)

  @@unique([id, tenantId])
  @@unique([tenantId, sourceType, sourceIdentityHash])
  @@index([tenantId, clientId, kind, effectiveAt])
  @@index([tenantId, actionExecutionId])
}

CustomerProfile.definition:
model CustomerProfile {
  id                 String     @id @default(cuid())
  tenantId           String
  clientId           String?
  userId             String?
  preferredLocale    String?
  privacyConsentAt   DateTime?
  marketingConsentAt DateTime?
  encryptedNotes     String?
  createdAt          DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime   @updatedAt
  tenant             Tenant     @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  client             Client?    @relation(fields: [clientId, tenantId], references: [id, tenantId], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Restrict)
  user               User?      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Restrict)
  membership         Membership? @relation("CustomerProfileMembership", fields: [userId, tenantId], references: [userId, tenantId], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Restrict)

  @@unique([userId, tenantId])
  @@unique([tenantId, clientId])
  @@index([tenantId, updatedAt])
}
